title: Shiraishi An — Past Excitement〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'll play it now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm giving this show absolutely everything I have!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So try to keep up, okay?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So this is RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The very event that you and the others are trying to surpass, An...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't believe it...! That was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know it was just a recording of the real thing, but it felt like I was actually there!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm speechless!
Was RAD WEEKEND really this amazing?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Calm down, will you?
It was absolutely amazing. We get it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But it really was super amazing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I totally know that feeling, Rin.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're seeing it through a screen, but it has this way of setting your heart on fire.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right?! A part of me wanted to cheer and jump with the crowd while I watched!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Same. It felt so real.
Despite it being a video, it had this incredible immersive effect.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for showing this to us, An. I think it's safe to say that this is a rare piece of history.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're welcome. I've been meaning to watch it again anyway.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Where my dream was born...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, really. Thank you very much for sharing this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, wait, we just left it running.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? It's supposed to end after the show finishes...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, listen...!
The screen's black but I think I hear something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

<Hey, is this thing actually recording?
Everything's all black.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This voice...!
<Hm? Haha! The lens cap was still on.>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
<How's that?
Ah, ah, ah. Hello, my name is Nagi Kotaki.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's the lady who sang during RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I didn't realize this included a video of something other than the show...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
<How was RAD WEEKEND?
Did you have fun?>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: <Just as a little disclaimer, I don't really know how it went since it hasn't actually happened yet...>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: <But I'm sure it was the best show ever.>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: <I mean, Taiga, Ken and everyone from Vivid Street helped put it together.>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: <Which is why I'd like to show you around the place I love so much. Vivid Street!>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: <I honestly don't know who's going to watch this when, but...>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: <I hope you like this city just as much as I do.>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: <Anyway, let's start our tour of the musician's paradise that's full of song and...>

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line:
<Hm? Hey, Nagi!
Where are Taiga and Ken? Are they not with you today?>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: <Oh, the owner of that ramen shop...! Perfect! Today's your day off, right? Mind being my cameraman for a bit?>

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: <What? Me?>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: <You were the one who said you filmed your daughter's relay during her sports competition really beautifully, right? So, here you go! Action!>

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line:
<Haha! Alright, you got me.
I'll play along, Nagi!>

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
<Thanks! Okay, once more.
Let's start our tour of the musician's paradise known as Vivid Street.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for that, MEIKO.
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome. Good luck with practice, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, the video after the show was really good too. We got to see so many different live houses!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And it was like everyone this Nagi lady crossed paths with was her friend! I can't believe how popular she was!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! That street's where you sing and hang out a lot, right, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup. It's called Vivid Street.
But that video had to be taken... Two, maybe three years ago...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, Nagi was right. That place we saw's totally a musician's paradise!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right?! It's like there were people singing or playing an instrument at every corner. Everyone listening looked like they were having fun too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. It was especially nuts after my dad and his team put on RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There were so many street musicians and performers that you'd literally run into one every few steps.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What?! That many?!
No way...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes way!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Did something flash over that way just now...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there's a ball or something on the ground. It's glowing too. This must've been the thing that flashed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, that might be...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: An, don't pick it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What's going on?!
S-So bright...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh...? Where are we?!
It looks like a street but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think a fragment of a feeling sent us to a different SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And you just had to pick it up, An...
I wasn't sure what was gonna happen...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
W-Wait just one minute!
What do you mean by “a fragment of a feeling”?! Also, a different SEKAI?!
